description: NWS watches, warnings, advisories. Point (city/ZIP/lat+lon): containing polygons. BBox or US state/DC/CONUS (codes, full names, US/national): intersecting polygons. A city miss is not a statewide all-clear — query the state or a bbox; never say regional inventory is impossible. NY/WA and "New York State"/"Washington State" are states; "New York"/"Washington" stay cities. Omit at for now; at (ISO-8601 UTC) is the snapshot then. Empty = all-clear or purged (~24h). alert_id = detail+geometry, ignores at. Ex: {"location":"WI","events":["Tornado Warning"]}.

alert_id.description: Alert identifier for detail mode. When set, location is ignored.

at.description: ISO-8601 UTC past instant for the in-effect snapshot. Ignored with alert_id.

bbox.description: Bounding box {west,south,east,north}; west/east are negative in the US. Skips geocoding; intersecting polygons.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Most tools also accept a `location` place-name string instead of lat/lon.

location.description: Free-text place: "City, ST" (e.g. "Portland, OR"), US ZIP, venue/address where enabled, or "lat,lon". Use this OR lat+lon, not both.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). For continental US use negative values (west of the prime meridian).

name: get_alerts

_sources.description: Per-source provenance: what produced these values and when.

valid_time.description: Echo of at when an as-of snapshot was requested.
